notes: Bedrock discovery (line 291-297) looks under a fixed worlds/ subdirectory (the shape a Bedrock slot's zip always has, per WorldSlotManager's create-slot Bedrock branch characterized in P6.5), preferring a name-matched child and otherwise taking firstSubdir's first non-__/non-. directory entry from FileManager's own (unspecified, not sorted) enumeration order -- unlike the Java branch's fallback, this one has NO lexicographic sort (line 280-289's firstSubdir helper just takes `entries.first(where:)` over contentsOfDirectory's raw order), so which world gets picked when worlds/ unexpectedly contains more than one entry is filesystem-enumeration-order-dependent, not deterministic. Worth the same flag as the Java case's ambiguity, but strictly less predictable since there's no sort at all here.
